references.text: The prohibition against having sexual relations with one's father's wife is first given here, and Leviticus 20:11 gives the penalty for this violation.
Repeats the prohibition against lying with one's father's wife and uncovering one's father's nakedness.
Declares a curse on anyone who lies with his father's wife.
Reuben lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine, an example of this sin in practice.
Jacob condemns Reuben for dishonoring his father's bed by lying with his concubine.
Absalom lay with his father's concubines, a public violation of this commandment.
Paul condemns a man in Corinth who had his father's wife, showing that this sin was also forbidden under the new covenant.
Ezekiel condemns those who uncover their father's nakedness, a reference to the same sin.
Amos accuses Israel of father and son going to the same woman, a similar sexual sin.
